character_facts: Lothar is directly addressed by name and is expected to carry out technical commands.

A second small companion/technician traveling with Lothar

Lothar or his companion complains that their craft or recording device was almost hit.

locations: A dense futuristic industrial/city environment under aerial attack
The interior or cockpit of an attacking command machine or station

The attackers use ships and energy weapons against the Metabunker.
A device or process called the Metabaron's bio-electrogram can be reactivated and is time-sensitive.
There exists a 'solidification program' that Lothar can activate.
A glowing faceted crystal or energy object is prominently associated with the attacking command figure's control station.
plot_events: A commanding figure orders an immediate attack on the Metabunker.
The attackers are told to destroy the target completely.
Ships and beam fire strike the Metabunker's city-like structures.
A smaller craft or device carrying two characters is nearly destroyed during the assault.
One character says there is limited time left to reactivate the Metabaron's bio-electrogram.
A large explosion or energy discharge fills the lower panels.
A character orders Lothar to activate a solidification program.

visual_summary: A command figure inside a large armored or mechanical station orders an immediate strike while holding or projecting a glowing faceted crystal. Outside, ships and energy beams attack a dense futuristic cityscape identified as the Metabunker. One small craft carrying two figures is nearly hit; they complain and focus on a countdown tied to reactivating the Metabaron's bio-electrogram. A large blast follows, and one figure orders Lothar to activate a 'solidification' program.
